profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Distributed Payment Systems at Zego | TypeScript, React, Node.js, PHP, Swift
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable full-stack applications. Currently leading development of distributed payment systems processing billions of dollars in transactions at Zego (a Global Payments company). Key contributor to platform modernization that led to $1B company valuation. Also an indie developer shipping a native macOS app (Swift/SwiftUI) end-to-end, and mobile app (react native). Proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions, leading teams, and architecting systems that drive business results.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Payment platform for Property Managers processing billions in annual transactions.

• Lead a team architecting Zego's distributed FlexPay system, enabling tenants to split rental payments—supporting a partnership accounting for 75% of company revenue
• Leading implementation of credit card payment authentication, targeting ~$16M in chargeback liability reduction and strengthening the risk management suite
• Maintain 99% uptime for mission-critical payment processing systems serving thousands of property managers nationwide
• Apply Domain Driven Design, C4 modeling, and Agile/Kanban methodologies to deliver complex distributed systems

Stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Nest.js, GraphQL, MySQL, MongoDB

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Sub-contractor with the United States Navy.

• Developed and maintained Project Management tool for Navy fleet operations using C#.NET and Angular
• Built data sanitization tools in Java for ship weather monitoring systems deployed across the fleet

projects.title: DiffSmith — AI Pull-Request Reviewer
projects.description:
Agentic developer tool (in progress) · 2026 – Present

• Building an LLM agent that reviews pull requests with real tools (file reads, codebase search, git history) instead of one-shot prompting
• Designed around an eval harness, a hand-labeled corpus of real PRs with regression scoring on every prompt change, so iteration stays evidence-based

Stack: TypeScript, Nest.js, Anthropic SDK, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Vitest

projects.title: Grocery Voice — Voice-First Grocery App
projects.description:
Founder & Developer · groceryvoice.app · 2026 – Present

• Shipped a voice-first grocery app end to end: speech is parsed by Claude into structured, aisle-organized lists, with recipe and nutrition generation from what you're buying
• Integrated the Kroger API for one-tap cart handoff—OAuth, fuzzy product matching with live prices, and an optimistic refresh-token rotation strategy for their single-use tokens
• Built a React Native (Expo) iOS app and feature-parity Next.js web app sharing end-to-end types via tRPC, with offline-first lists and a non-interactive EAS pipeline to TestFlight

Stack: React Native, Expo, Next.js, tRPC, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Claude API, Kroger API, Vercel
